templates.title: Decode a FLAC recording to PCM16 WAV
templates.description: Choose a native FLAC (16-bit mono or stereo, known length, with an MD5). The WAV is the exact decoded PCM in a canonical header, ready for SoX conform. The MD5 check shows file consistency, not authenticity.

templates.title: Archive a PCM16 WAV as lossless FLAC
templates.description: Choose a canonical PCM16 mono or stereo WAV. The FLAC decodes back to exactly the same PCM samples; WAV metadata chunks are dropped and the FLAC carries no tags.

templates.title: Archive a PCM16 WAV as lossless FLAC with title, artist and description
templates.description: Like the plain archive, plus up to three labels you write (title, artist, description) stored as native Vorbis comments, exactly as written, and read back from the published FLAC. They are declared text, not a verified identity; decoding drops them.
